signals.name: Significant detour (transit ≫ planned)
signals.rationale: Trip travelled >25% more than the Google route — off-route detour.

signals.name: Stoppage dominates transit time
signals.rationale: Stoppage hours ≥ 40% of transit hours with min 1hr stoppage.

signals.name: Transit distance far exceeds Google distance
Suspicious low unloading time
signals.rationale: Cargo offloaded in < 6 minutes after a multi-hour transit — likely concealed offload.

signals.name: Slow loading at origin
signals.rationale: Loading dwell ≥ 3h suggests pre-trip tampering or substitution window.

signals.name: Destination entry missing
signals.rationale: Trip closed without a destination-geofence entry event on a non-trivial trip.

signals.name: ETA breached significantly
signals.rationale: Trip closure ≥4h past the Google ETA — extended off-route or unaccounted dwell.

signals.name: Alerts fired during trip
signals.rationale: One or more in-transit alerts (geofence, halt, route-deviation) raised by the platform.

signals.name: Route matches a known theft case
signals.rationale: Same (origin_code, destination_code) pair as a confirmed theft incident — geographic-level repeat pattern.
